notes: NEW MODE: CONTACT HIGH (infected). Everyone starts as a survivor, then one player turns. The infected glow green, have no guns, run faster and kill with one hit up close - and anyone they get joins them. Survive 5 minutes, or spread it to everyone. Offline with bots, online and in private matches.

NEW MODE: BACK ALLEY (2v2 gunfight). Two against two, one life a round, 40 seconds. Everyone gets the SAME random loadout (new every two rounds); when time runs out the team with more health left wins. First to 6 rounds. Offline, online and in private matches.
